gloss: two years; for two years; period of two years

definitions.gloss: two years; period of two years
definitions.explanation: A duration of two years. The {間|かん} suffix emphasizes a continuous span of time, distinguishing this from {二年|にねん} which can also mean 'second year.'

examples.japanese: {二年間|にねんかん}⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I worked hard for two years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二年間|にねんかん}⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: He worked at this company for two years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修士|しゅうし}→修士：11098_shuushi⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二年間|にねんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{修了|しゅうりょう}→修了：11655_shuuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A master's program is two years long, and completion requires submitting a thesis.

notes:
Adds the duration suffix ⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ to ⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧, making the meaning unambiguously 'for two years' rather than 'second year.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二年間|にねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: two years of experience
- {二年間|にねんかん}⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue for two years
- {二年間|にねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧: a two-year study-abroad period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧: two years; second year — shorter form, can be ambiguous between duration and ordinal
- ⟦{二年生|にねんせい}→二年生：27586_ninensei⟧: second-year student — ordinal, not duration
